title: LDAP configuration
searchFilterHint: Optional. Limits which entries are found at login at all, e.g. (objectClass=person) for persons only. Combined via AND with the search for the login name; anyone who does not match counts as “not found”. For groups, use “User groups”.
nestedGroupsHint: Members of sub-groups of the configured groups may log in too. Works with Active Directory only, not OpenLDAP.
allowedGroupsHint: Members of these groups log in with the user role. Admin and moderator groups need not be listed here again. Group name (cn, on Active Directory also the pre-Windows 2000 name; searched in the whole tree below the base DN) or full DN, e.g. for groups outside the base DN. Separate names with commas, DNs with semicolons. A name that exists more than once does not count – enter the DN instead. Only members of a user, admin or moderator group may log in; if all three are empty, nobody can.
moderatorGroupsHint: If a user is in both an admin and a moderator group, admin wins.
